desc: Summon a blade of Cursed Flames. Your aerial attack and flourish are now enhanced by these flames. While using Cursed Flames, your mantra cooldowns are 3 times longer.
name: Accursed Flame
additional_info: Triples all Mantra cooldowns while using Cursed Flames. Upon using an uppercut, fire a purple flame projectile in front of you at high speeds. This applies Cursed Burn if it lands. Upon using an aerial attack, throw a fire projectile diagonally downwards and in front of you, applying Cursed Burn if it lands. Cursed Burn is a unique burn modifier that turns your burn light purple, overriding any other recolor, and triples its damage output.
